The '''J-Eight-O soldier droid''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|combat]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] class that was discontinued prior to the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Despite this, [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Jet Nebula]] owned a J-Eight-O called [[Clunker]].<ref name="FA" />
